title: Scoped Role Builder — Live Audit Preview for Console Admins
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Ship a compact, admin-friendly 'Scoped Role Builder' flow in Console that lets operators compose roles, assign members/groups, preview live audit output, and simulate permission effects before committing. This reduces misconfiguration risk for SSO-synced orgs and makes audit trails immediately visible to reviewers.

Rationale: Current role editing flows are verbose and separate from audit logs. Admins often iterate between the Role Editor, Member pages, and the Audit Log, increasing cognitive load and time-to-fix. Combining a compact role composer with a live 'Audit Preview' and member-suggestion UX will improve velocity for platform teams and reduce security incidents caused by mistaken privilege grants.

Scope: Scoped Role Builder UI, inline member assignment with SSO group suggestions, live audit preview that renders the immediate resulting audit entry (who, what, before/after diff), permission simulation sandbox for a single principal, compact role diff snapshot for approval workflows. Integrations: SSO group-sync mapping, existing audit-log backend (read-only preview), and Console rollouts (canary).

Out of scope: Backend audit storage migration, RBAC core evaluation engine changes, bulk CSV import redesign (will link to existing flow), and tenant-level policy enforcement engine (separate EPIC).
acceptance_criteria: Designs show a single-screen compact builder that fits in Console's standard modal and desktop panels
Inline member assignment supports live suggestions from SSO group mappings and shows conflict indicators when external group membership will override local assignments
Audit Preview renders a realistic audit log entry (actor, timestamp, role delta, affected principals) and matches backend logging format for at least 95% of fields

Permission simulation can run for a selected principal and display 'allowed/denied' for targeted console actions without requiring a backend change (client-side simulation using exported policy snapshot)
Role diff snapshot (compact) can be copied or exported as a changelog for review, and is included automatically in rollout canary notes
Design reviewed and signed off by Security (Priya Nair) and Product (Jonah Patel) with follow-ups captured as tasks
tasks: Create initial low-fidelity wireframes that fit both modal and side-panel contexts
Design member-suggestion microflow for SSO group mappings and local overrides
Define Audit Preview schema with backend team and create sample payloads
Prototype permission-simulation UX with example actions and visual states
Work with Eng to define telemetry points (role_changed, member_assigned_preview, simulation_run)
Prepare design spec and handoff (Figma + Confluence PRD)
decisions: Keep Audit Preview read-only in first iteration to avoid coupling edits to audit backend; show realistic entries derived from the proposed change
Implement permission simulation client-side using a policy snapshot to avoid blocking on evaluation service changes; server-side evaluation considered for Phase 2
Inline member suggestions prioritized for orgs with SSO group sync; fallback to name/email search for non-SSO orgs
Expose a compact role diff that uses color-coded +/− rows instead of full JSON to aid reviewer comprehension
comments: 2026-01-24 — Initial sync: sketched three patterns (full-page editor, modal compact, side-panel). Team favored modal compact for speed and side-panel for deep-edit fallback.
2026-01-28 — Engineering review (ENG-33211): backend audit team confirmed read-only preview is feasible using current endpoints; fields mapping documented in Confluence PRD.
2026-02-02 — Security review (Priya Nair): requested explicit visual indication when assignment is inherited from SSO group, and a confirmation step when granting high-privilege roles. Added as task.
2026-02-05 — PM feedback (Jonah Patel): ask to prioritize permission-simulation for write actions (create tokens, change routing) as customers frequently test those Æ flows. Reprioritized task list.
2026-02-09 — Design critique: adjusted compact diff to show action-level granularity (route-level allow/deny) rather than only scope-level; uploaded updated mockups to Figma.
2026-02-11 — Handoff prep: created handoff bundle and added QA checklist. Linked proposed telemetry events in the PR.

2026-02-12 — Blocker discovered: SSO group sync API returns paginated group IDs but not consistent display names for nested groups. ENG-33890 created to resolve. This blocks full-name suggestions in member microflow; fallback implemented to display group ID with tooltip.
